name: ⛏️ Pickaxe Mining Simulator
desc:
Welcome to ⛏️ Pickaxe Mining Simulator ⭐ UPDATE EVERY WEEKEND

⛏️ Grab your pickaxe and start mining straight down!
💥 Break through layers of earth and reach the bottom!
🏆 Every time you reach the end, earn Wins!
💰 Hatch pets to boost your cash and mine faster!
⚡ Upgrade your pickaxe, unlock better tools, and become the best digger!
🎯 Compete with others and climb the leaderboards!

🚀 Like & Favorite for updates with exciting features and content!

🌟 Can you collect the most Wins and become the ultimate digger? Start now!
